messages:
maria: Hey team :wave: Thinking about a lightweight Grafana dashboard + alert family to track 'warm-slot' behavior and power ramp events. We keep seeing long tail latency on first requests after slot allocation. Want panels for: slot state (cold/warm), allocation latency, per-GPU power ramp slope, and mem fragmentation. Anyone up for a quick panel spec?

ben: I can sketch panels. Quick Q: do we want per-tenant heatmaps or per-rack rollups? per-rack is cheaper to query but loses tenant signal.

maria: Start per-rack + a filtered quick-link to tenant view. The goal is on-call triage first then cost analysis later.

raj: For alerts: two families — fast symptomatic alerts (ramp-failure, cold-alloc-latency > X) for oncall, and slow drift alerts (avg mem frag > 0.7 for 24h) for infra/eng. Agree?

claire: +1. Also add a panel for 'power ramp slope' using derivative on power watts over 30s; triggers when slope < expected_threshold for 2 consecutive samples. We had one incident where GPUs never reached target and got throttled.

xi: Here are two PromQL candidates:```
# per-GPU power slope (watts/sec)
deriv(avg_over_time(nvidia_power_watts{job="gpu-metrics"}[30s]))

# cold alloc latency (seconds)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(gpu_alloc_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, rack))
```
Not perfect but a start.

ben: For dashboard layout: top row: rack map + overall health score. Second row: time-series: avg alloc latency, alloc rate, warm vs cold ratio. Third: heatmaps for mem frag and power anomalies. Bottom: quick runbook + links to tenant dashboard and runbook doc.

maria: Can someone add a small Prometheus recording rule for warm_ratio so queries are cheap? sketch: warm_ratio = count_over_time(gpu_slot_state{state="warm"}[5m]) / count_over_time(gpu_slot_state[1m])

raj: I'll add recording rules to infra repo. Proposed names: infra:gpu:warm_ratio:5m and infra:gpu:power_slope:30s.

ops-bot: NOTE: Recording rules require a CI change. Opened PR #4123 in infra-monitoring (will link when ready).

claire: Alert thresholds idea:
- alloc_latency_p95_rack > 5s for 5m -> severity=prod-warning
- power_slope_p95_rack < 20 W/s for 2m -> severity=prod-critical
- mem_frag_avg_rack > 0.75 for 24h -> severity=infra-action

ben: Also propose an annotation stream for 'slot_warmup_started' events so grafana can correlate allocation spikes with ramp issues. We can emit a metric like gpu_slot_warmup_ts{rack,slot}=unix_ts on start.

maria: love that. For dashboard templating variables: region, rack, tenant, model_size. Keep default time window 1h. For dashboard UID we can use 'warm-slot-ops' and keep JSON small. I'll take ownership of the grafana JSON and wire the panels.

raj: I added the recording rule PR and a draft alert config. tagging @claire @ben for review.

ben: I'll put together a minimal grafana json export and share in this thread. Expect a draft in ~2h.

maria: thanks all. If anyone hits the same slow cold allocations, paste a short trace here (timestamps + rack) and we'll correlate with power_slope. :mag:

ops-bot: deploy-bot: grafana/dashboard/sync succeeded for uid=warm-slot-ops at 2245130300

maria: deployed! I'll iterate on panel thresholds after a week of data. :thumbsup:
